key_insight: Clifford disentanglers reduce entanglement in molecular wavefunctions while preserving Pauli-string Hamiltonian structure, improving simulation efficiency without changing the underlying qubit representation.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical, structure-preserving preprocessing step for tensor-network and shallow-circuit quantum simulations that can lower bond-dimension requirements and reduce sensitivity to orbital ordering and mapping choices.
method: Classify Clifford operators by their effect on the Schmidt spectrum across a bipartition.
Reduce the search to compact representative sets for 2-qubit and 4-qubit cases (20 and 91,392 representatives).
Integrate the best Clifford transformations into an iterative Clifford-augmented MPS workflow and also test them in VQE settings.
evidence_signal: Across the molecular test cases studied, the approach reduced energy errors at fixed bond dimension and improved robustness to orbital ordering and fermion-to-qubit mapping choices; it also benefited shallow-circuit VQE calculations.
watch_item: The search space is still restricted to classified Clifford representatives, so performance may depend on the molecule, correlation structure, and the practicality of identifying the best transformation.
paper_title: Clifford disentanglers for entanglement reduction in molecular electronic structure simulations
